notes.title: ver 1.0.46, pre-release update
notes.content:
We are excited for the coming release this Friday!
Minor changes for version 1.0.46:

[olist]
[*] skipped level don't always update
[*] pixelated assets updated
[*] fixed wrong keys displayed
[*] flowers in spring are more joyful
[*] water in winter is more blue
[*] fixed pause menu button behavior
[*] added some fresh new bugs
[/olist]
